en.title: Key Ideas At a Glance and Questions

source.title: Precalculus: A Unit Circle Approach, 4th edition

concepts.title: 恒等式与共同定义域
concepts.summary: 逐项变形必须对原式有定义的值成立。

method.title: 方法
method.body: $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$，$1+\tan^2x=\sec^2x$，$1+\cot^2x=\csc^2x$。$\tan x=\sin x/\cos x$，$\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$；$\csc x=1/\sin x$，$\sec x=1/\cos x$。正弦、正切、余切、余割为奇函数，余弦、正割为偶函数。先列分母限制，再从一边推到另一边。一个共同定义域内的反例即可否定恒等式。

en.title: Identities and the common domain
en.summary: Each transformation must hold wherever the original expressions are defined.

method.title: Method
method.body: $\sin^2x+\cos^2x=1$, $1+\tan^2x=\sec^2x$, $1+\cot^2x=\csc^2x$. Also $\tan x=\sin x/\cos x$, $\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$, $\csc x=1/\sin x$, $\sec x=1/\cos x$. Sine, tangent, cotangent, and cosecant are odd; cosine and secant are even. State denominator restrictions, then transform one side into the other. One counterexample in the common domain disproves an identity.

concepts.title: 和差、倍角、半角与和积
concepts.summary: 按角的结构选择公式，并检查符号与分母。

method.title: 方法
method.body: $\sin(u\pm v)=\sin u\cos v\pm\cos u\sin v$；$\cos(u\pm v)=\cos u\cos v\mp\sin u\sin v$；$\tan(u\pm v)=(\tan u\pm\tan v)/(1\mp\tan u\tan v)$，正切公式要求原式各项有定义。$\sin2x=2\sin x\cos x$；$\cos2x=1-2\sin^2x=2\cos^2x-1$；$\tan2x=2\tan x/(1-\tan^2x)$。$\sin(x/2)=\pm\sqrt{(1-\cos x)/2}$，$\cos(x/2)=\pm\sqrt{(1+\cos x)/2}$，符号由 $x/2$ 的象限决定。$\sin^2x=(1-\cos2x)/2$、$\cos^2x=(1+\cos2x)/2$。积化和差与和差化积可把多角表达式因式分解。

method.title: 积化和差与和差化积
method.body: $\cos u\cos v=\tfrac12[\cos(u-v)+\cos(u+v)]$；$\sin u\sin v=\tfrac12[\cos(u-v)-\cos(u+v)]$；$\sin u\cos v=\tfrac12[\sin(u+v)+\sin(u-v)]$；$\cos u\sin v=\tfrac12[\sin(u+v)-\sin(u-v)]$。$\sin u\pm\sin v=2\sin((u\pm v)/2)\cos((u\mp v)/2)$；$\cos u+\cos v=2\cos((u+v)/2)\cos((u-v)/2)$；$\cos u-\cos v=-2\sin((u+v)/2)\sin((u-v)/2)$。这些公式对所有实角成立。

method.title: 正切半角与降幂条件
method.body:
$	an(x/2)=\pm\sqrt{(1-\cos x)/(1+\cos x)}=\sin x/(1+\cos x)$，要求 $\cos x
e-1$，根式符号按 $	an(x/2)$ 的符号选择。另一式 $	an(x/2)=(1-\cos x)/\sin x$ 须 $\sin x
e0$，不能在分母为零处约分延用。$	an^2x=(1-\cos2x)/(1+\cos2x)$ 须 $\cos x
e0$。

en.title: Sum, difference, multiple-angle, and product formulas
en.summary: Choose a formula from the angle structure and check signs and denominators.

method.title: Method
method.body: $\sin(u\pm v)=\sin u\cos v\pm\cos u\sin v$; $\cos(u\pm v)=\cos u\cos v\mp\sin u\sin v$; $\tan(u\pm v)=(\tan u\pm\tan v)/(1\mp\tan u\tan v)$ where all original terms exist. $\sin2x=2\sin x\cos x$, $\cos2x=1-2\sin^2x=2\cos^2x-1$, and $\tan2x=2\tan x/(1-\tan^2x)$. The signs in $\sin(x/2)=\pm\sqrt{(1-\cos x)/2}$ and $\cos(x/2)=\pm\sqrt{(1+\cos x)/2}$ depend on the quadrant of $x/2$. Use $\sin^2x=(1-\cos2x)/2$ and $\cos^2x=(1+\cos2x)/2$ to reduce powers. Product-to-sum and sum-to-product formulas factor expressions with several angles.

method.title: Product-to-sum and sum-to-product
method.body: $\cos u\cos v=\tfrac12[\cos(u-v)+\cos(u+v)]$; $\sin u\sin v=\tfrac12[\cos(u-v)-\cos(u+v)]$; $\sin u\cos v=\tfrac12[\sin(u+v)+\sin(u-v)]$; $\cos u\sin v=\tfrac12[\sin(u+v)-\sin(u-v)]$. Also $\sin u\pm\sin v=2\sin((u\pm v)/2)\cos((u\mp v)/2)$; $\cos u+\cos v=2\cos((u+v)/2)\cos((u-v)/2)$; $\cos u-\cos v=-2\sin((u+v)/2)\sin((u-v)/2)$. These formulas hold for all real angles.

method.title: Tangent half-angle and power-reduction domains
method.body:
$	an(x/2)=\pm\sqrt{(1-\cos x)/(1+\cos x)}=\sin x/(1+\cos x)$ requires $\cos x
e-1$, with the square-root sign selected from the sign of $	an(x/2)$. The alternative $	an(x/2)=(1-\cos x)/\sin x$ requires $\sin x
e0$; cancellation does not restore excluded points. The power-reduction formula $	an^2x=(1-\cos2x)/(1+\cos2x)$ requires $\cos x
e0$.

concepts.title: 三角方程与区间筛选
concepts.summary: 先求完整角族，再对原变量筛选和检验。

method.title: 方法
method.body: $\sin t=\sin\alpha$ 给 $t=\alpha+2k\pi$ 或 $t=\pi-\alpha+2k\pi$；$\cos t=\cos\alpha$ 给 $t=\pm\alpha+2k\pi$；$\tan t=\tan\alpha$ 给 $t=\alpha+k\pi$，$k\in\mathbb Z$。令 $t=bx+c$ 时，解完整方程后除以 $b\ne0$；$b=0$ 时直接判断常数等式。因式分解时不约去可能为零的因子；平方后代回原式排除增根。弧度与度数分别用 $2\pi$ 与 $360^\circ$ 的周期。

pitfalls: $\arcsin$ 值域 $[-\pi/2,\pi/2]$；$\arccos$ 值域 $[0,\pi]$；$\arctan$ 值域 $(-\pi/2,\pi/2)$。

en.title: Trigonometric equations and interval filtering
en.summary: Find complete angle families, then filter and check the original variable.

method.title: Method
method.body: $\sin t=\sin\alpha$ gives $t=\alpha+2k\pi$ or $t=\pi-\alpha+2k\pi$; $\cos t=\cos\alpha$ gives $t=\pm\alpha+2k\pi$; $\tan t=\tan\alpha$ gives $t=\alpha+k\pi$, $k\in\mathbb Z$. For $t=bx+c$, solve for $t$ and divide by $b\ne0$; if $b=0$, test the constant equality directly. Do not cancel a factor that could vanish. Substitute after squaring to remove extraneous roots. Use periods $2\pi$ in radians and $360^\circ$ in degrees.

pitfalls: The principal ranges are $[-\pi/2,\pi/2]$ for $\arcsin$, $[0,\pi]$ for $\arccos$, and $(-\pi/2,\pi/2)$ for $\arctan$.

concepts.title: 图像与应用模型
concepts.summary: 振幅、相移、周期和情境定义域共同确定答案。

method.title: 方法
method.body: $a\sin x+b\cos x=R\sin(x+\phi)$，$R=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}>0$，用 $\cos\phi=a/R$、$\sin\phi=b/R$ 选正确象限。若 $a=b=0$，函数恒零。模型只取物理有效的时间或角。画图标出函数、周期、关键点和渐近线。

en.title: Graphs and applications
en.summary: Amplitude, phase, period, and the physical domain determine the answer.

method.title: Method
method.body: $a\sin x+b\cos x=R\sin(x+\phi)$, $R=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}>0$, with $\cos\phi=a/R$ and $\sin\phi=b/R$ selecting the quadrant. If $a=b=0$, the function is identically zero. Restrict models to physically valid times and angles. Label the function, period, key points, and asymptotes in a graph.

exercises.prompt: K1. 验证 $\dfrac{\sin x}{1+\cos x}+\dfrac{1+\cos x}{\sin x}=2\csc x$ 时应从哪一侧开始？

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 左侧较复杂，先通分。原式要求 $\sin x\ne0$；这也排除 $1+\cos x=0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $\dfrac{\sin^2x+(1+\cos x)^2}{\sin x(1+\cos x)}=\dfrac{2(1+\cos x)}{\sin x(1+\cos x)}=2\csc x$。

en.prompt: K1. Which side should you start with when verifying the identity $\dfrac{\sin x}{1+\cos x}+\dfrac{1+\cos x}{\sin x}=2\csc x$?

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The left side is more complicated. Combine its fractions; require $\sin x\ne0$, which also excludes $1+\cos x=0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\dfrac{\sin^2x+(1+\cos x)^2}{\sin x(1+\cos x)}=\dfrac{2(1+\cos x)}{\sin x(1+\cos x)}=2\csc x$.

exercises.prompt: K2. 用倒数恒等式验证 $\dfrac{\cot x}{\csc x}=\cos x$：用什么分别替换 $\cot x$ 和 $\csc x$？

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$，$\csc x=1/\sin x$，要求 $\sin x\ne0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $\dfrac{\cos x/\sin x}{1/\sin x}=\cos x$。第一处用商恒等式，第二处用倒数恒等式。

en.prompt: K2. To verify $\dfrac{\cot x}{\csc x}=\cos x$ using the reciprocal identities, replace $\cot x$ by ____ and $\csc x$ by ____.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\cot x=\cos x/\sin x$ and $\csc x=1/\sin x$, requiring $\sin x\ne0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\dfrac{\cos x/\sin x}{1/\sin x}=\cos x$. The first replacement is the quotient identity; the second is the reciprocal identity.

exercises.prompt: K3. $x=\pi$ 可用于证明 $\cos x=\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}$ ____ 恒等式。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 代入 $x=\pi$，左侧 $\cos\pi=-1$，右侧 $\sqrt{1-0}=1$。两侧都有定义但不等。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 正确的全局关系是 $\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}=|\cos x|$。

en.prompt: K3. The value $x=\pi$ can be used to prove $\cos x=\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}$ is ____ an identity.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: At $x=\pi$, the left side is $-1$ and the right side is $\sqrt{1-0}=1$. Both are defined but unequal.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The globally valid relation is $\sqrt{1-\sin^2x}=|\cos x|$.

exercises.prompt: K4. 解 $\cos4x=-1$，先写为 $\cos4x=\cos\alpha$，并在“QII”中选择 $\alpha=$____。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $\cos\pi=-1$，故 $\alpha=\pi$。严格说 $\pi$ 的终边在负 $x$ 轴上，并不在第二象限内部；原题的 QII 应包含此边界来理解。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $4x=\pi+2k\pi$，故 $x=\pi/4+k\pi/2$，$k\in\mathbb Z$。

en.prompt: K4. To solve $\cos4x=-1$, first rewrite it as $\cos4x=\cos\alpha$, and choose $\alpha=$____ in QII.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $\cos\pi=-1$, so $\alpha=\pi$. Strictly, its terminal side is on the negative $x$-axis, not in the interior of QII; the original wording must be understood to include this boundary.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $4x=\pi+2k\pi$, so $x=\pi/4+k\pi/2$, $k\in\mathbb Z$.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 反余弦要求 $-1\le x\le1$；在主值区间 $[0,\pi]$ 内，$\cos\pi=-1$。

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Arccosine requires $-1\le x\le1$. In its principal range $[0,\pi]$, $\cos\pi=-1$.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 反正弦要求 $-1\le x\le1$；在主值区间 $[-\pi/2,\pi/2]$ 内，$\sin(-\pi/2)=-1$。

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Arcsine requires $-1\le x\le1$. In its principal range $[-\pi/2,\pi/2]$, $\sin(-\pi/2)=-1$.
